note: Parameters for engine/weather.js and the clouds section of the page. Decision: FINDINGS.md, 'Weather: local and directional sky cover' and 'Cloud forecast source'. Values marked provisional have no outside source.

sources.cloudTopM: Provisional. No source found. Chosen high so that only a sight line above almost all cloud is treated as clear. A lower value shortens every ray.
sources.topArcFraction: Ben's choice, 2026-10-15: only the top of the arc matters; he agreed to 0.8. It keeps the top 20 percent of each track's highest elevation. A fixed 20 degree limit was rejected: 17 of 60 visible snapshot launches never reach 20 degrees.
sources.maxReachM: Ben's choice, 2026-10-15, when the NWS grid gave a forecast 59 km offshore and none at 107 km. The page now uses Open-Meteo NBM, which answered 174 km offshore (2026-10-16), so the grid edge no longer sets this limit. Kept at 60 km; see PLAN, Open questions.
sources.bearingStepDeg: Provisional. Our choice, to keep the number of forecast requests small. Not a physical value.
sources.spacingM: Provisional. Our choice, to keep the number of forecast requests small.
sources.forecast: Cloud forecast test, clouds/README.md: NBM total cloud scored best of four models at every lead from 1 to 7 days; HRRR low cloud scored best for low cloud at short lead. NBM answered 8 days ahead and HRRR about 42 hours ahead from the page on 2026-10-16. 'days' is the forecast_days asked for; the page treats a launch as out of range when no value comes back.
